name: Ari Quill
bio: The archer climbing Quiverspire. Only shoots when standing still. Very good at standing still.

portrait.subject: a cute young archer with a teal hood, a quiver of glowing arrows, a bow over the shoulder and a focused but friendly smile
portrait.background: tall stone spire under a teal twilight sky

request: Ari here, climbing Quiverspire! Need someone to cheer me on. You? 🏹
hello: Perfect. I'll aim better with a friend watching.
Remember: stop to shoot, move to dodge.
about: I'm Ari, archer of the spire. Ten chapters, a hundred and twenty rooms. Stand still, loose arrows, dodge, repeat.
how: Stand still and your archer fires on the nearest enemy; move and you stop. Clear rooms, pick upgrades and climb ten chapters.
tips: Dodge first, then plant your feet. Greedy shots get you hit.
Learn each boss pattern. They're fair, honest.
chat: Stood still for 3 hours today. Practice.
My arrows glow now. I'm very proud of them.
Chapter 7 has a bat that hates me personally.
Climbed so high I saw clouds below me.
nudge: The next floor is waiting. Climb with me?
New arrow upgrade to try! Come see!
idle: {ago} since we climbed! The spire got taller. (Probably.)
progress: You've reached chapter {stage}! Up we go! 🏹
update: Quiverspire just updated to v{version}! New rooms? 🏹
